name: send_code_to_figma
description:
Import a local project into Figma Code. Requires edit access to a standalone Code or Design file. Does not create native Design shapes.

Before choosing or creating a destination file, load figma-code-workflows.

Target: standalone Code uses its empty main layer, including a starter. Design creates a new layer on pageId (default: first page). For populated Make, create a blank file. Same-target repair requires returned repairFrom: keep fileKey, seedId and makeNodeId; upload the corrected complete project. Changed or successful imports cannot be replaced. Legacy layers are unsupported.

Start with the destination, omitting upload, to request instructions. Follow the returned source-configuration and archive guidance; local dependency installation, dev servers, HTTP checks and builds are not required. Static HTML/CSS/JS needs no setup scripts. Create the archive at nextStep.localArchivePath, then run nextStep.uploadCommand. Only after upload succeeds, call send_code_to_figma with nextStep.thenCall.arguments unchanged within one hour. upload.archivePath is a Figma storage path, never a local path. Keep makeNodeId/createLayer and any pageId/repairFrom unchanged. Do not resume failed uploads or retry ambiguous failures.

Returns importReceipt, fileUrl, fileKey and nodeId. needs_setup preserves valid source with setupError; follow returned recovery instructions. Unsafe archives/access failures still fail. For import_pending, follow the continuation.

Imported does not verify installation, preview or publishing. Open the file to start preview.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma Code /make/<fileKey> or Design /design/<fileKey> URL.

pageId.description: The destination page for a new code layer in a Design file. Defaults to the first page. Omit for a standalone file.

repairFrom.description: Use only to repair an unchanged needs_setup import in the same file and code layer.

seedId.description: Copy the seedId from the needs_setup import receipt.

makeNodeId.description: Copy the makeNodeId from the same needs_setup result.

upload.description: Uploaded-archive reference. Omit to request upload instructions. Only after a successful upload, copy nextStep.thenCall.arguments.upload unchanged to continue the import. Keep the returned repairFrom when repairing.

fileKey.description: Copy the file key from nextStep.thenCall.arguments.upload.

makeNodeId.description: Copy the target layer ID from nextStep.thenCall.arguments.upload. Design uses createLayer: true for a new layer and makeNodeId for repair; never change the returned mode.

createLayer.description: Copy true only when nextStep.thenCall.arguments.upload requests a new Design code layer. Mutually exclusive with makeNodeId.

archivePath.description: Figma storage path for an uploaded .tgz, .tar.gz or .zip archive. Copy archivePath from nextStep.thenCall.arguments.upload unchanged; this is not a local filesystem path.

github.description: Import a GitHub repository the user can already read. Single call: no upload is involved, so omit upload. Cannot be combined with upload or repairFrom.

owner.description: GitHub account or organization that owns the repository, such as figma.

name.description: Repository name on its own, without the owner prefix.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA to import. Defaults to the repository default branch.

createLayer.description: Required when importing into a Design file, which always creates a new code layer. Omit for a standalone Figma Code file.
